content.description: A fast-paced, upbeat commercial jingle with a rhythmic pop beat. A female vocalist sings the lyrics with a bright, enthusiastic, and cheerful tone. The energetic melody features electronic percussion and a bouncy rhythm that matches the dynamic visual cuts.
A distinct, soft thumping sound, resembling a packaged item being placed firmly onto a hard surface, followed by a subtle crinkling of the packaging.
A brief, wet splatting sound, characteristic of a raw liquid ingredient dropping heavily into a soft, crumbly mixture.
A sharp, muted clapping sound of hands coming together, accompanied by a quick, airy whoosh as powder scatters outward.
A crisp, active, and continuous sizzling sound, characteristic of food frying and bubbling in hot oil on a pan.
A short, sharp puff of air, mimicking the sound of someone blowing sharply to cool down a piece of hot food.
A heavy, solid metallic thud, representing multiple heavy refrigerator doors being slammed shut simultaneously.

content.speaker: an unseen female narrator
content.description: A clear, spoken voiceover delivering the brand tagline in Russian. The female voice speaks in a warm, affectionate, and reassuring tone at a steady, moderate pace.

shots.shot_transfer: The opening shot shows a close-up of [PERSON_1]'s hand holding [OBJECT_1] in [SCENE_1].

visual_description.sub_shot_content: [SCENE_1] shows a blue-themed kitchen, where bright and even lighting illuminates the light white wooden countertop. The shot is taken from a medium close-up perspective.
[PERSON_1] is wearing a bright orange shirt. He brings [OBJECT_1] into view and places it firmly upright on a light-colored wooden surface using his right hand.
[PERSON_1] gently tears off the top of [OBJECT_1] with the fingertips of his left hand, while holding it steady on one side with his right hand.
[PERSON_1] moves his hips from side to side.

shots.shot_transfer: Hard cut to a three-way vertical split screen showing [PERSON_2], [PERSON_1], and [PERSON_3] in their respective kitchens.

visual_description.sub_shot_content: A three-way vertical split screen featuring [SCENE_2] on the left, [SCENE_1] in the middle, and [SCENE_3] on the right.
[PERSON_2], [PERSON_1], and [PERSON_3] tilt the torn packaging bag downward, pouring the fragile white substance from [OBJECT_1] into yellow, blue, and pink bowls placed on the table.

shots.shot_transfer: Suddenly, there is a close-up shot from above, showing a bowl divided into three sections.

visual_description.sub_shot_content: A close-up view of a bowl, with its inner surface vertically divided into three equal parts.
A cascade of white, crumbly cottage cheese continuously rains down into the colorful bowl, quickly filling its base.
A single, bright yellow raw egg yolk drops forcefully from above, landing dead center on the fluffy mound of cottage cheese and sinking slightly into it.

shots.shot_transfer: Hard cut to a medium close-up of [PERSON_2] in [SCENE_2].

visual_description.sub_shot_content: Set in [SCENE_2], a medium close-up highlights [PERSON_2] against a vibrant yellow and orange backdrop.
Wearing a green open shirt, [PERSON_2] flashes a wide, enthusiastic smile as he raises both flour-dusted hands inward toward his chest.
[PERSON_2] claps his hands together sharply, sending a dramatic, expanding cloud of white flour dust billowing outward between him and the camera.

shots.shot_transfer: Hard cut to a top-down close-up of round cheese pancakes in a dark frying pan.

visual_description.sub_shot_content: A top-down close-up view directly above a dark, non-stick frying pan.

shots.shot_transfer: Hard cut to a side profile close-up of [PERSON_2].

visual_description.sub_shot_content: A medium close-up side profile shot of [PERSON_2] against a warm yellow background serves as the opening visual layout for this sequence.
[PERSON_2] raises a silver fork holding a golden-brown cheese pancake, bringing it eagerly toward his partially open mouth.
With his eyes focused on the hot pancake, [PERSON_2] purses his lips and blows sharply on the food to cool it down.

A horizontal split screen layout emerges during this timeframe, showing [PERSON_2] in the top half while the bottom half is vertically split into blue, yellow, and pink thirds displaying separate actions.
In the top half, [PERSON_2] bites into the pancake, closes his eyes in delight, and happily chews the food while tilting his head slightly.
In the bottom three panels, people use both hands to pick up the forks and lift the pancakes from the plates.
A three-way vertical split screen layout also appears within this sequence, showing the full-body backs of [PERSON_1], [PERSON_2], and [PERSON_3] standing in their respective kitchens.
From behind, [PERSON_1], [PERSON_2], and [PERSON_3] confidently turn around in [SCENE_1], [SCENE_2], and [SCENE_3], walking towards those tall and brightly colored refrigerators.
The three individuals simultaneously pull open their refrigerator doors, exposing brightly lit interiors completely filled with meticulously arranged rows of [OBJECT_1].

shots.shot_transfer: Hard cut to a six-panel grid showing close-ups of the characters and hands holding [OBJECT_1].

visual_description.sub_shot_content: A dynamic 3x2 grid layout displays alternating character portraits and product shots, featuring bright, uniform lighting across all six panels.
Occupying alternating panels, [PERSON_1], [PERSON_3], and [PERSON_2] look directly at the camera, offering warm, engaging smiles against their respective blue, red, and yellow backgrounds.
In three other alternating scenes, a hand quickly emerges into view and is placed in the upper left corner of [OBJECT_1].
The hand quickly removes [OBJECT_1] from the frame.
A brief Russian disclaimer gradually appears, always positioned in the center at the bottom of the screen.

shots.shot_transfer: Hard cut back to a three-way vertical split screen showing [PERSON_2], [PERSON_1], and [PERSON_3] in their kitchens.

visual_description.sub_shot_content: A return to the three-way vertical split screen displays wide views of [SCENE_2] on the left, [SCENE_1] in the center, and [SCENE_3] on the right.
Standing behind their counters, [PERSON_2], [PERSON_1], and [PERSON_3] cheerfully bob their heads and energetically dance in place, shaking their shoulders in rhythm to the music.

shots.shot_transfer: Hard cut to a static display of food products against a blue background.

visual_description.sub_shot_content: A static close-up presents a neatly arranged table setting against a softly blurred, cool blue background.
On the table, a white plate stacked with golden cheese pancakes and a fresh mint sprig sits alongside a bowl of white sour cream, [OBJECT_1], and matching branded dairy products.
The scene transitions, and in the upper left corner of the screen, a blue heart-shaped logo appears, displaying the text "Искренне Ваш," accompanied by the pre-written slogan "Искренне мой...".
